lifespan.source_note: ASICS generally recommends replacing running shoes every 300–500 miles, depending on the runner, surface, and wear. They do not publish a precise official mileage rating per model. This dashboard uses 400 miles as the typical midpoint for a daily trainer, 300 as the check-for-wear mark, and 500 as the upper end of that range. Lifespan is an estimate, not a guarantee.

footnote: Only running miles count. Walking, golf, cycling, and other activities are not added — we cannot assume those were done in these shoes.
